text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft didn't show up for training, 
so I went out to look for her.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“—Mumble mumble... ...The sun is... so 
nice and warm today, too...”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Huh!? Trainer? ...N-No way, is it really 
that time already!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It was so comfortable that I overslept. 
...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I made sure to firmly caution Line Craft 
so that the same thing wouldn't happen 
again."
